class.name: SteamLeaderboardQuery
class.brief_description: A branchable leaderboard read bound to one Steam client scope.
class.description: Start with [method SteamLeaderboards.query] and choose a selection. Each modifier returns an independent branch. The default selection is the first ten global ranks. A stopped scope leaves its queries unavailable.

method.name: around_me
method.description: Returns a branch centered on the signed-in player's score. The nonnegative counts before and after the center plus the center row must total at most 100.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Looks up the existing board and fetches the selected page. Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamLeaderboardPageResult]. Immediate errors return the same result type.

method.name: fetch_operation
method.description: Starts the same query as [method fetch] and returns a retained operation for cancellation, completion, or typed result inspection.

method.name: friends
method.description: Returns a branch that reads the signed-in player's friends view with a display cap from 1 to 100 rows.

method.name: global_ranks
method.description: Returns a branch that reads [param count] global ranks from the one-based [param first_rank]. The count must be between 1 and 100.

method.name: users
method.description: Returns a branch for 1 to 100 distinct individual SteamID64 values in decimal. Only players with scores appear in the page. Steam accepts one selected-user download at a time across the shared runtime. An overlapping download returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY].
